context.why: This feature is built, reviewed and open for the maintainer's review. He read the running API and asked for three changes, recorded in specs/011-restful-api/decisions.md D25 and as tasks T068 to T070 in tasks.md Phase 9. The specification is already changed to match (FR-003, FR-036, FR-044, User Story 5 scenario 5). Make exactly these three changes.
prior_decisions: decisions.md D25 is the whole instruction; read it.

T068: the scheme name `knoxApiToken` comes from drf-spectacular's built-in extension for knox (see .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/drf_spectacular/contrib/knox_auth_token.py or wherever the installed package defines it). Give the schema the name `tokenAuth` with a description that says in plain words that a token from the account pages is sent as `Authorization: Token <token>`, by subclassing that extension in fairdm/api/schema.py with a higher priority (drf-spectacular's documented way to override a built-in extension), and make sure the module is imported when the API app loads. Check the scheme name used under each operation's `security` changes with it. The word knox must not appear in any scheme name or description in the schema. Existing tests in tests/test_api/test_schema.py or test_settings.py that pin `knoxApiToken` describe what this replaces: update them and name them in progress.md.

T069: add a read-only `html_url` field: the absolute address of the record's own page on the portal, from the model's get_absolute_url() made absolute with request.build_absolute_uri. Declare it once on RecordSerializer (fairdm/api/serializers.py) beside `url`, placed directly after `url` in the output, so projects, datasets and every registered sample and measurement type carry it, including a developer's serializer that builds on the bases; add it to common_fields where those are listed, and to ContributorSerializer for people and organisations. Without a request in the serializer context return the path alone. It must add no database query per record: check TestQueryCount still passes, and if get_absolute_url of any of these models reads a relation, load it on the queryset. The start-up check that compares writable fields, and the schema tests that compare components with serializers, must still pass. References to other records ({uuid, url}) do not change.
T069's test requests the returned address with the Django test client as someone who may see the record and expects the page (status 200), for each of the six kinds.

T070: in fairdm/api/viewsets.py the two catalogue views build entries with name, verbose_name, verbose_name_plural, app_label, endpoint, fields, filters and count. Remove fields, filters and app_label from the entries and from the entry serializer that describes the response in the schema. Keep the count's rule (only what the caller may see). tests/test_api/test_router.py has tests for the removed keys from an earlier story: delete or change those and name them in progress.md. tests/test_api/test_viewsets.py::TestEveryListedFilter reads each type's filter names from the catalogue: change it to read them from the API's filter set for that type (the same class FairDMFilterBackend builds, fairdm/api/filters.py), keeping what it proves, that no listed filter answers 500. These edits to existing tests are authorised.

Documentation: docs/portal-development/restful-api.md and the page for people using a portal describe the catalogue entries and the authentication scheme; make them true, add `html_url` where a record's fields are described, and add a line for each of the three changes to this feature's entry in CHANGELOG.md (the entry there still says catalogue entries have `filters` in place of `filterable_fields`: correct it to say what an entry now holds).
Update feature-state.json for T068, T069 and T070 (status, attempts, evidence with tests, commands, code as path:line, verified_by_ci) and tick them in tasks.md.
Write your completion report to specs/011-restful-api/report-fix-2.json. Do not run `ruff check` with fixing over the whole tree: it rewrites unrelated test files. Lint only the files you touch.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the generated schema, then its security schemes are named tokenAuth and cookieAuth, nothing in them names the package, and operations refer to the new name.

Given each of the six kinds of record, then list and record responses carry html_url, the absolute address of its portal page, which returns the page when requested, and a value sent for it is ignored.
Given the catalogues, then an entry holds name, verbose_name, verbose_name_plural, endpoint and count only, and the every-filter test still covers every filter of every type.
